blocks.text: Nikhil ne chai banayi thi. Meenakshi uske paas baith gayi, hospital ka bag abhi bedroom mein hi pada tha. Kal raat ke baad subah pehli baar dono ko aaraam se baithne ka waqt mila tha. Nikhil ne uska cup apni taraf kheenchkar dekha.

blocks.speaker: Nikhil
blocks.text: “Thandi ho gayi?”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Thodi si. Rehne do, pee lungi.”

Taiyaar hone ke baad usne teal kurte ke upar cream shawl daali aur kandhe ke paas pin laga li. Bag uthaate waqt use gaadi ki chaabi yaad aayi. Kal badminton court ke paas gaadi start nahi hui thi. Babloo ne kaha tha ki zarurat padi toh woh mechanic bula dega.

blocks.speaker: Nikhil
blocks.text: “Main chalun tumhare saath?”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Abhi sirf chaabi deni hai. Tum Vihaan ke paas raho. Mechanic kuch bolega toh phone karungi.”
Auto ne use court ke bahar utaara. Babloo gaadi ke paas khada tha. Meenakshi ko dekhkar usne phone jeb mein rakha aur gaadi ke usi taraf aa gaya jahan woh khadi thi.

blocks.speaker: Babloo
blocks.text: “Madam, mechanic ne bola das minute.”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Kal bhi gaadi ne mujhe kaafi wait karwa liya. Aaj main hospital jaaungi. Tum mujhe phone kar dena.”

blocks.speaker: Babloo
blocks.text: “Ji. Chaabi de dijiye.”

Meenakshi ne bag khola aur chaabi ungli mein atka kar bahar nikaali. Ring ke saath shawl ka ek dhaaga bhi upar aa gaya. Usne doosre haath se shawl pakdi aur ring ko zara sa ghumaya. Dhaaga chhootne ke bajaay aur andar phans gaya.
Usne neeche dekhte hue chaabi apni taraf kheench li. Shawl tan gayi. Gale ke paas halki si tik hui.
Tik.
Babloo ka haath chaabi lene ke liye aage tha. Aadha raasta aakar ruk gaya.

Meenakshi ne ring se nazar uthayi. Ek pal pehle woh chaabi dekh raha tha. Ab uski nazar thodi upar thi. Meenakshi samajh paati ki woh kahan dekh raha tha, usse pehle hi Babloo gaadi ki taraf mud gaya.

blocks.speaker: Babloo
blocks.text: “Madam… pin khinch gayi hai.”
Meenakshi ne neeche dekha. Kurte ka upar wala button khul gaya tha. Usne shawl apni taraf kheench li.

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Ek second.”
Usne chaabi phir se shawl ke paas laayi. Dhaaga dheela pada toh ring nikal gayi. Button band karte waqt uski ungli pehli baar loop se phisal gayi.

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Haan. Ab lo.”
Babloo muda. Is baar usne seedha Meenakshi ke chehre ki taraf dekha. Chaabi lekar usne poochha:

blocks.speaker: Babloo
blocks.text: “Mechanic jo bole, aapko phone kar doon?”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Haan. Main hospital jaa rahi hoon.”
Sadak tak pahunchte hi usne cab book ki. App par gaadi ka number aa gaya, lekin woh ek pal screen ko dekhti reh gayi.
Babloo ne pin ke baare mein toh bata diya tha. Par uska haath uske bolne se pehle kyun ruk gaya tha?

scenes.title: The M08 Review
scenes.location: CityCare Hospital · administrative wing → conference room

blocks.text: 08:55 AM · Aditi's morning — reader-only cutaway

New Year party ki lights abhi bhi bedroom ke ek kone mein jal rahi thi. Aditi ne aankhein kholi. Avi aur Yash uske paas the. Kal raat ki lambi baaton, hansi aur affectionate kisses ke baad teeno ko der se neend aayi thi.

blocks.speaker: Aditi
blocks.text: “Tum log abhi bhi yahin ho?”

blocks.speaker: Avi
blocks.text: “Good morning toh kehne do.”

blocks.speaker: Yash
blocks.text: “Aaj hospital ka plan kya hai?”
Aditi ka phone vibrate hua. Screen par Meenakshi ka naam tha. Usne call utha li.

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi (phone)
blocks.text: “Aditi, M08 review hai aaj. Tum aa rahi ho?”

blocks.speaker: Aditi
blocks.text: “Haan, Meenu. Thodi late ho sakti hoon. Tum review shuru kar lena.”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Okay. See you.”
Call khatam hui. Meenakshi ko Aditi ki private New Year night ke baare mein kuch pata nahi tha.
09:00 AM · Hospital arrival

Cab hospital ke entrance par ruki. Meenakshi ne payment ki, apna bag sambhala aur seedha administrative wing mein chali gayi. Teal embroidered kurta, cream trousers aur subah wali cream fringed shawl ab bhi uske saath thi. White coat pehente hue usne shawl ko kandhe ke paas adjust kar liya. Keyring ke jhatke ke baad upper fastening ab bhi theek se tik nahi raha tha; usne use jaisa-taisa secure samajhkar chhod diya.
Desk par phone silent karte hue usne Babloo ka pending mechanic update dekha. Subah chaabi lete waqt Babloo ka haath ek pal ko kyun ruk gaya tha, yeh sawaal abhi bhi uske dimaag mein tha.

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi (to herself)
blocks.text: “Ab report par dhyaan do.”
10:20 AM · Report preparation

Usne M08 file kholi, supporting sheets sahi order mein rakhi aur presentation ka last section dobara check kiya. Aaj normal routine ko stretch karne ka waqt nahi tha: do senior doctors ke saamne briefing deni thi.
10:55 AM · Conference room
Dr. Kunal Bedi pehle se apne notes dekh rahe the. Dr. S. P. Khurana saamne wali chair par baithe the.

blocks.speaker: Kunal
blocks.text: “Good morning, Doctor Meenakshi.”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Good morning, sir.”

blocks.speaker: Khurana
blocks.text: “Complete M08 report ready?”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Yes, sir. Presentation aur supporting sheets dono.”
Usne laptop connect kiya, remote uthaya aur file table par rakhi.
11:00 AM · The review begins

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Sir, first section mein revised observations hain. Main supporting figures bhi share karungi.”

blocks.speaker: Kunal
blocks.text: “Show us the supporting page.”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Of course.”
11:18 AM · The accidental moment

Meenakshi jaise hi report uthane ke liye aage jhuki, white coat ke dono panels alag ho gaye aur kurte ka upper button khula hone ki wajah se uski deep cleavage aur breasts ka upper curve dono seniors ko clearly dikh raha tha. Meenakshi ka poora dhyaan report par tha, isliye use bilkul ehsaas nahi hua.
Kunal ki nazar report se ek pal ke liye hati. Khurana ne bhi sir uthaya. Meenakshi page nikaal kar unki taraf badha rahi thi; unhone kitni der aur kya dekha, uska use andaza nahi tha.

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Here, sir. Yeh revised figures hain.”

blocks.speaker: Khurana
blocks.text: “Hmm. Continue.”
11:19 AM · Still unaware

Meenakshi seedhi hui, screen ki taraf mud kar next slide explain karne lagi. White coat ka front khula hi raha; shawl apni original position par nahi aayi thi. Usne discussion khatam kiya, questions ka jawab diya aur note kiye hue changes confirm kar liye.
11:40 AM · Review concludes

blocks.speaker: Kunal
blocks.text: “Report satisfactory hai. Signed copy administration ko de dijiye.”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Certainly, sir.”
Laptop disconnect karke woh file lekar bahar aa gayi.
11:45 AM · Realisation

Staff washroom ke mirror ke saamne woh ruk gayi. Cream shawl ek taraf khisaki hui thi aur teal kurte ka upper fastening phir khula hua tha. Usne pehle coat ka front milaya, phir kurte aur shawl ko sambhala.

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi (under her breath)
blocks.text: “Oh God... main meeting mein bhi aise hi thi?”

Use table par aage jhukna yaad aaya. Kunal aur Khurana dono saamne baithe the. Usse apne kapdon ki position ab saaf samajh aa rahi thi, lekin woh unke exact reactions ya nazar ki duration confirm nahi kar sakti thi.
Subah Babloo ka ruka hua haath bhi yaad aaya. Usne ek baar dobara fastening check ki, file uthayi aur staff room ki taraf chal di.
11:47 AM · Changing-area corridor

Meenakshi conference room se nikal kar staff changing-area corridor ki taraf badhi. Teal kurta ka upper fastening phir se khul gaya tha. Usne cream shawl se usse cover karne ki koshish ki, lekin walking ke dauran baar-baar slip ho raha tha. White coat abhi uske kandhe par tha.

Usse pata tha ki women’s staff changing area ke andar uska assigned locker hai. Usmein spare formal suit rakha hua tha — dark green kurta-set jo usne emergency ke liye rakha tha. Ab usse change karna zaroori lag raha tha. Rounds aur departmental kaam abhi baaki the, aur damaged fastening ke saath aage badhna practical nahi tha.

Corridor mein traffic kam tha. Do nurses door se nikal kar opposite direction mein chali gayin. Meenakshi ne apna ID card adjust kiya aur changing area ke door ke paas pahunchi. Usne ek baar peeche dekha. Koi senior nazar nahi aa raha tha. Usne door push kiya aur andar enter kar gayi.
Andar lockers ka row saamne tha. Uska locker right side se teesra tha. Spare suit usi mein tha. Usne coat utaar kar bench par rakha aur locker key nikaali.
M3.02 · First unexpected discovery
Meenakshi ne locker key lock mein daali aur turn kiya. Door khulte hi uski nazar andar gayi.

Dr. Kunal Bedi locker ke bilkul saamne khada tha. Uska haath abhi bhi uske folded spare suit ke paas tha. Dark green kurta ka ek corner uski ungliyon ke neeche se dikh raha tha. Kunal ne turant haath peeche kheench liya.
Meenakshi ruk gayi. Key abhi bhi uske haath mein thi. Kunal ne uski taraf dekha, phir locker ki taraf, phir wapas uski aankhon mein. Uska chehra tight ho gaya.

blocks.speaker: Kunal
blocks.text: “Meenakshi… main… door khula laga.”

Meenakshi ne kuch nahi kaha. Usne sirf dekha — Kunal ka position, uska haath jo ab side mein tha, aur locker ke andar ka suit jo thoda sa bahar nikal aaya tha. Uski saans ek second ke liye ruki, lekin usne chehra neutral rakha.
Usne key wapas lock mein daali, door dheere se band kiya, aur bina kisi aur word ke do kadam peeche hati. Kunal ne usse rokne ki koshish nahi ki. Woh wahi khada raha.
Meenakshi corridor ki taraf mud gayi. Uski chaal normal thi, lekin uske haath mein key ab bhi tightly pakdi hui thi.
M3.03 · Waiting outside
Meenakshi corridor mein kuch kadam aage badh kar ruki. Usne peeche mud kar nahi dekha. Changing area ka door ab band tha. Kunal andar hi tha.
Uski ungliyan abhi bhi locker key ko tightly pakde hue thi. Usne key ko apni coat ki pocket mein daal diya. Saans dheere se chhodi, lekin uska dil tez chal raha tha.

Usne jo dekha tha, woh clear tha — Kunal uske locker ke saamne khada tha, haath uske spare suit ke paas. Door pehle se open tha ya usne khola, yeh usse nahi pata tha. Usne koi sawal nahi kiya. Na usne Kunal ko roka, na kuch kaha.

Meenakshi ne apna shawl theek kiya. Teal kurta ka fastening abhi bhi loose tha, lekin ab uska dhyaan us par nahi tha. Usne socha ki abhi andar wapas jaana theek nahi. Kunal abhi wahan tha. Usse change karne ke liye room khaali chahiye tha.

Woh corridor ke end tak gayi, nursing station ke opposite wall ke paas ruki, aur phone nikaal kar screen dekhne lagi. Koi message nahi bheja. Sirf time pass kiya. Uski aankhein screen par thi, lekin dimaag mein wahi image ghoom rahi thi — Kunal ka haath, uska suit, aur uska turant peeche hatna.
Kuch minute baad usne phone band kiya. Usne decide kiya ki thodi der aur wait karegi. Jab room clear ho jaaye, tab wapas jaayegi. Abhi kuch nahi bolegi. Na Kunal ko, na kisi aur ko.
M3.04 · Second separate discovery · 11:58 AM
Meenakshi ne phir se changing area ke door ki taraf dekha. Corridor ab khaali tha. Usne socha shayad Kunal nikal gaya hoga. Usne door dheere se push kiya aur andar jhaki.

Dr. S. P. Khurana locker row ke paas khada tha. Meenakshi ka locker ab band tha, lekin Khurana ka haath door ke handle par tha. Woh jaise use check kar raha tha ki latch properly engage hua hai ya nahi. Uske doosre haath mein koi file nahi thi. Sirf woh aur locker.
Meenakshi ruk gayi. Is baar usne door poora nahi khola. Sirf itna ki Khurana clearly dikh raha tha. Khurana ne abhi usse notice nahi kiya tha. Uska dhyaan locker par tha.
Meenakshi ne dekha — Khurana ne handle ko ek baar aur turn karke check kiya, phir haath hata liya. Uska chehra serious tha. Woh ek pal locker ki plate ko dekhta raha, phir mudne laga.
Meenakshi ne turant door dheere se band kar diya. Usne peeche hati aur corridor ke kone mein chali gayi. Khurana ko pata nahi chala ki use kisi ne dekha.

Uske dimaag mein do images ab saath mein thi — pehle Kunal ka haath uske suit ke paas, ab Khurana ka haath uske locker ke handle par. Dono alag the. Dono ne kuch kaha nahi. Aur usne bhi kuch nahi kaha.
M3.05 · Second silent withdrawal
Meenakshi corridor ke kone mein khadi rahi. Uski peeth wall se lagi hui thi. Usne aankhein band ki aur ek gehri saans li.
Pehle Kunal. Ab Khurana.

Dono alag-alag time par uske locker ke paas the. Dono ne usse kuch nahi kaha. Aur usne bhi kuch nahi kaha. Uska dimaag tez chal raha tha. Surprise tha, discomfort tha, aur neeche se ek halki si gussa bhi. Lekin usne abhi kisi ko confront karne ka faisla nahi kiya.

Usne socha — agar woh abhi andar jaati aur sawal karti, toh kya hota? Khurana chairman hai. Kunal senior hai. Uske paas koi clear evidence nahi tha ki unhone andar kya kiya. Sirf unka presence tha. Aur usse change bhi karna tha. Teal kurta ka fastening abhi bhi loose tha. Rounds baaki the.
12:07 PM · Same outfit, different decision

Changing area ka corridor aakhir khaali ho gaya. Meenakshi dheere se andar gayi, bench par rakha white coat uthaya aur locker par ek nazar daali. Dark green spare suit ab bhi wahi tha. Usne use haath nahi lagaya.

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi

Teal kurte ka upar wala fastening ab bhi bharosemand nahi tha. Usne shawl ko pin ke paas se zara better set kiya, white coat pehni aur file lekar records office ki taraf chal di. Woh same cream shawl, teal embroidered kurta aur white coat mein thi. Kapde badalne ka iraada badal gaya tha; kapde nahi.

Naveen ne register desk par rakha. Meenakshi ne signatures check kiye. Kunal aur Khurana ke naam dekhte hi use changing room ka corridor yaad aaya. Ek pal ke liye uska mood phir badla, magar Naveen ki saamne-se aayi chhoti-si complaint ne use wapas current moment mein la diya.

Meenakshi shelf ke paas gayi aur file tak pahunchne ke liye haath upar badhaya. Uski white coat ka front khul kar dono taraf ho gaya. Cream shawl kandhe se sarak aayi. Kurte ka pehle se loose upper fastening bhi apni jagah se hat gaya; neckline khulne se upper chest aur cleavage ek pal ke liye zyada visible ho gayi.

Naveen uske saamne se file number dekhne ki koshish kar raha tha. Uski nazar ek pal ko neeche gayi, phir woh turant side mein dekhne laga. Meenakshi ka poora dhyaan folder ke spine par tha; usne abhi situation notice nahi ki.

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi

blocks.speaker: Naveen

12:23 PM · An easier laugh

Meenakshi ne file neeche laakar dekha. Shawl khisak gayi thi aur fastening phir khula tha. Usne shawl theek ki aur coat ke front panels mila diye. Ek pal ke liye usse subah Babloo aur 11 baje ki briefing dono yaad aa gaye.

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Great. Aaj toh meri dress bhi overtime kar rahi hai.”
Naveen ne halka sa hanskar nazar file par kar li.

blocks.speaker: Naveen
blocks.text: “Aap change kar leti toh shayad aaram rehta.”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Haan, socha tha. Phir mann badal diya.”

blocks.speaker: Naveen
blocks.text: “Kyun?”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Tumhare register ki wajah se. Pehle yeh complete karao.”
Dono hans diye. Meenakshi ka tone relaxed tha. Woh nahi chahti thi ki changing area ki baat abhi kisi aur conversation mein aaye. Naveen ne bhi kapdon par aur discussion nahi ki.
12:30 PM · A deliberate but ordinary compliment
Naveen pages arrange kar raha tha. Meenakshi ne shawl ek kandhe par comfortably set ki aur blue folder band kar diya. Is baar usne jaan-boojhkar usse halka sa personal sawaal poochha.

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi

blocks.speaker: Naveen
blocks.text: “Bahut achha lagta hai. Bas aap logon ko compliment dene mein risk lagta hai.”

blocks.speaker: Meenakshi
blocks.text: “Risk lene ko kisne kaha? File sahi jagah rakha karo, bas.”

Naveen hans diya. Meenakshi ne uska expression dekha aur khud bhi muskura di. Uske aas-paas ka pressure poori tarah gaya nahi tha, lekin uske paas ab ek normal conversation thi jisme woh apne aap ko phir se sambhaal pa rahi thi.
12:35 PM · Scene pause

Naveen signed copies lekar bahar gaya. Meenakshi wahi teal kurta, cream shawl aur white coat pehne desk par rahi. Spare suit locker mein hi tha. Agla deliberate interaction alag scene mein plan hoga; yahan sirf accidental moment aur ek light conversational seed complete hua hai.

scenes.title: The Seed
scenes.location: Meenakshi's office → service corridor → semi-private staff wing

blocks.text: M6.01 · After Naveen
Naveen ke jaate hi office ka door band hua. Meenakshi kuch seconds wahi khadi rahi. Din bhar ke accidents, glances aur ab uska apna deliberate choice — sab ek hi line mein jud gaye the.

Usne white coat aur cream shawl wapas pehenne ki jaldi nahi ki. Teal front-button kurta waise hi raha. Glass cabinet ke reflection mein khud ko dekhkar uske chehre par ek chhoti, almost naughty smile aayi.
“Ek baccha hone ke baad bhi… I still have it.”
Thought vanity se zyada self-recognition tha. Usse Naveen ki reaction pasand aayi thi, aur ye maanna ab uske liye pehle se aasaan tha.
M6.02 · Her name in the corridor
Bag close karke woh service corridor ki taraf nikli. Store-room side se Harish Pal aur Sunil Yadav ki dheemi awaaz aa rahi thi. Woh seedha nikal jaati — phir usne apna naam suna.

blocks.speaker: Harish
blocks.text: “Doctor Meenakshi…”

Bas itna kaafi tha. Meenakshi ke steps ruk gaye. Aaj pehli baar usse genuinely jaan-na tha ki hospital ke men uske baare mein uski absence mein kya kehte hain. Woh door ke paas gayi, lekin andar enter nahi kiya.
M6.03 · Rupa

blocks.text: Door poora band nahi tha. Meenakshi ko pehle Rupa dikhi. Woh store-room shelving ke paas khadi thi, Harish uske ek side aur Sunil doosri taraf.
